newsitem.title: USA: ComEd sees Ill. nuke back on line Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: ComEd sees Ill. nuke back on line Tuesday.

text.p: Commonwealth Edison Co's (ComEd) 789 megawatt (MW) Quad Cities nuclear unit 1, which has been shut since February 10 for refueling, is likely to reconnect to the grid on Tuesday, the company said Monday.
"Quad 1 should be on line sometime tomorrow," said company spokesman Art Massa.
Quad Cities 2, also located in Cordova, Ill., is operating at its full 789 MW power.
ComEd's 1,040 MW Zion 1 nuclear unit in Zion, Ill., has also returned to full power after reconnecting to the grid last Thursday, Massa said.
The unit was shut August 18 due to problems in the main steam isolation valves.
